data.body: Implemented and pushed to Gerrit change 1438 (stacked on d9f5/1436; both touch pyproject.toml so sequential landing is conflict-free). scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py (490 LOC) + .github/complexity-baseline.json (69 live ceilings, generated via the wrapper from the current-tree census) + pyproject [tool.ruff.lint.mccabe] max-complexity=15 + make lint wiring + tests/unit/test_complexity_baseline.py (72 tests) + runbook update. Live C901 census=69 (max validate_scorer 16>15); --check prints 'active=69 new=0 increased=0 stale=0' exit 0. Independent held-out mutation probes (parent-run, not the implementer's tests) confirmed the gate catches new/increased debt and rejects all schema violations, and that symbol identity (nested equal-leaf under different parents, dup-qualified-key redefinition) resolves correctly. make lint green, 72/72 tests pass.
